options.content:
Two streams, two questions. **Builds** (`job="supply-chain-build"`) is filed by `ci:sign` the moment an image is signed and both attestations are attached — it says what was *built*. **Inventory** (`job="supply-chain-inventory"`) is a nightly walk of the digests pinned in committed values, verifying each SBOM off the registry — it says what an environment is *pointed at*, which is the question a CVE asks.

This is a research surface, not the incident path (ADR-0501). Nothing here alerts, and nothing here links into the Overview funnel: come when you have a question, not when a pager goes off.

panels.title: Images signed (24h)
panels.description: One per signed image, across every service. A day with merges and none of these is a publish pipeline that stopped signing.

panels.title: Pinned images with a verifiable SBOM
panels.description: From the most recent nightly walk. Anything below the total is an image an environment is pinned to whose bill of materials cannot be read — which is exactly the image you cannot answer a CVE about.

panels.title: Pinned images WITHOUT one
panels.description: The finding. A non-zero here does not page anyone; it means the next CVE question has a blind spot of this size.

panels.title: Packages in the largest pinned image
panels.description: Read off the verified SBOMs. Not a health number — a sense of how much surface a single image carries, and how much a base-image change moves it.

panels.title: Signed builds by service
panels.description: Publish rate per service. A service that stops appearing here while its code keeps changing is a service whose images stopped being signed — which admission will notice later, at deploy time.

panels.title: SBOM size by service
panels.description: Package count per pinned image over time. A step change is a base-image or dependency-tree change; it is the cheapest early signal that an image gained a lot of surface without anyone deciding to.

targets.expr: max by (service) (max_over_time({job="supply-chain-inventory", env=~"$env"} | json | unwrap packages [6h]))

panels.title: Build records
panels.description: One line per signed image: digest, commit, ref and the run that produced it. This is the audit trail — 'when was this digest built, and from what' — and the reason digest and commit are in the line rather than in labels.

panels.title: Inventory: images that could not be verified
panels.description: Each line carries the reason cosign gave, so 'no attestation was ever attached' reads differently from 'signed with a key we no longer hold'. Empty is the expected state.
